checks.name: A position-only character query followed by an angular-velocity edit must retain the native current angle

scope: Actual isolated compiled-WASM probe using production World and mediaAudit16 bundling, with one kinematic box, gravity/air friction zero, and controlled frame/settings calls in Node. Native angle advanced to 1/60 while display remained 0; moveCharacterBox translated by [1,0] without an angle request; angular velocity changed to 2 before the next 1/60 frame. Not browser/device or full character-game certification.
